workspace_undo.description: Action button on a toast (after clearing the workspace, or after translating the composed message). Very short.

workspace_compose_translated.description: Toast after the composed message was translated before sending. $from$ and $to$ are language names (e.g. English, Spanish).

workspace_compose_same_language.description: Toast when the user asks to translate the composed message into the language it is already in. $language$ is a language name.

workspace_compose_translate_unavailable.message: Translation is not available for that language here.
workspace_compose_translate_unavailable.description: Toast when the on-device translation model cannot translate into the chosen language.

workspace_crx_saved.description: Status line after a signed Chrome extension package was saved. $name$ is the file name (e.g. my-extension.crx).

workspace_crx_save_failed.message: Couldn't save automatically - hit Save to try again.
workspace_crx_save_failed.description: Status line when the automatic save of a signed .crx file failed; 'Save' refers to the Save button below it (workspace_save_file).

workspace_sign_blocked_age.message: age messages can't be signed - SSH keys have no signature format here.
workspace_sign_blocked_age.description: Reason shown on the dimmed Sign toggle when SSH (age) recipients are selected. 'age' is the name of an encryption format, keep lowercase.

workspace_sign_blocked_no_pgp_key.message: signing needs an OpenPGP key of your own - SSH keys can't sign.
workspace_sign_blocked_no_pgp_key.description: Reason shown on the dimmed Sign toggle when the user has no OpenPGP private key. Starts lowercase in English.

workspace_cleared_toast.description: Toast after the whole workspace (text, files and recipients) was cleared with a double Escape; has an Undo action.

workspace_text_cleared_toast.description: Toast after the message text was cleared with the Clear text button; has an Undo action.

workspace_clear_input_output.description: Tooltip and accessible label of the icon button that resets the workspace (input and result).

workspace_recipients_label.description: Label of the recipient picker in encrypt mode.

workspace_no_contacts_yet.description: Empty state of the recipient picker when the user has no contacts.

workspace_add_a_contact.description: Button in the recipient picker's empty state; goes to the Keys tab.

workspace_age_message_note.message: age message - SSH recipients can't be mixed with PGP
workspace_age_message_note.description: Small note under the recipient picker once SSH recipients are selected: the output will be an age-format message. 'age' is a format name, keep lowercase.

workspace_sign_kind_crx.description: Toggle button choosing to sign a zipped extension as a Chrome .crx package. Keep '.crx'.

workspace_sign_kind_pgp.description: Toggle button choosing a plain PGP signature for a zipped extension instead of a .crx package.

workspace_sign_with.description: Label of the private-key selector in sign mode and next to the Sign toggle.

workspace_decrypt_with.description: Label of the private-key selector in decrypt mode.

workspace_no_keys_yet.description: Empty state of the private-key selector when the user has no keys.

workspace_create_one.description: Button in the key selector's empty state; goes to the Keys tab to create a key. 'one' = a key.

workspace_select_signing_key.description: Placeholder of the dropdown choosing which Chrome extension signing key to use.

workspace_toggle_encrypt_to_self.description: Toggle in encrypt mode: also encrypt the message to the user's own key so they can read it later. One of 3-4 toggles sharing a single row in a ~380px panel: about 14 characters at most. A short phrase ('Also to me') beats a full sentence; never abbreviate with a full stop.

workspace_toggle_password.description: Toggle in encrypt mode that adds a message password (symmetric encryption). Shares a single row with 2-3 other toggles: one word, about 12 characters at most.

workspace_toggle_zip_files.description: Toggle badge in encrypt mode: bundle several files into one zip before encrypting. One short word: it shares a single row with three other toggles.

workspace_toggle_save_to_history.description: Toggle in encrypt mode: record the operation in the history list. Shares a single row with 2-3 other toggles: about 12 characters at most. The toggle's on/off state carries the verb, so the word for 'History' alone is right where the full phrase is long.

workspace_self_excluded_intro.message: You won't be able to read this one:
workspace_self_excluded_intro.description: Start of a warning under the 'Also encrypt to me' toggle when none of the user's own keys can be added to this message. Followed by workspace_self_excluded_age or workspace_self_excluded_pgp, then the 'Import one' link.

workspace_self_excluded_age.message: you have no SSH key of your own, and an age message can't include a PGP one.
workspace_self_excluded_age.description: Reason following workspace_self_excluded_intro for an age (SSH recipient) message. Starts lowercase in English.

workspace_self_excluded_pgp.message: none of your own keys can be added to this message.
workspace_self_excluded_pgp.description: Reason following workspace_self_excluded_intro for a PGP message. Starts lowercase in English.

workspace_import_one.description: Link after the self-excluded warning; goes to the Keys tab to import a key. 'one' = a key.

workspace_enter_message_password.description: Placeholder of the inline password field when a password-protected message is being decrypted.

workspace_enter_key_password.description: Placeholder of the inline password field when the selected private key needs unlocking.

workspace_decrypting.description: Button label while a password decrypt is running.

workspace_unlocking.description: Button label while a key is being unlocked with the typed password.

workspace_go.description: Fallback label of the button next to the inline password field (encrypt/verify modes). Very short.

workspace_save_file.description: Button that saves the signed Chrome extension package. $name$ is the file name (e.g. my-extension.crx).

workspace_verifying.description: Button label while a .crx signature is being checked.

workspace_reset.description: Main button label after a verify completed; clears the workspace.

workspace_verify_signature.description: Main button label in verify mode when a .crx file is staged.

workspace_processing.description: Main button label while an operation is running.

workspace_sign_for_web_store.description: Main button label when signing a zipped extension as a Chrome .crx package. 'Web Store' = the Chrome Web Store.

workspace_need_recipient_or_password.message: Select at least one recipient, or set a password
workspace_need_recipient_or_password.description: Tooltip on the disabled Encrypt button when nothing can open the message yet.

workspace_clear_text.description: Button in the strip under the message box that empties it (undoable). The strip is already full of tools: use the shortest natural word for 'Clear' (about 10 characters at most), since 'text' is clear from where it sits. Becomes an icon with this as its label when it still doesn't fit.

workspace_message_input_aria.description: Accessible label of the main message textarea.

workspace_placeholder_decrypt.message: Paste the encrypted message you received...

workspace_placeholder_verify.message: Paste the signed message to check...

workspace_placeholder_compose.description: Textarea placeholder in encrypt and sign modes.

workspace_private_key_pasted_title.message: This looks like a private key. Don't paste private keys here.
workspace_private_key_pasted_title.description: Bold first line of the red alert shown when armored private-key material is pasted into the message box.

workspace_private_key_show_cleartext.message: Show the pasted text in cleartext
workspace_private_key_show_cleartext.description: Tooltip of the Ignore button that removes the masking of a pasted private key.

workspace_private_key_ignore.description: Small button on the private-key alert that reveals the masked text anyway. Very short.

workspace_private_key_pasted_body.message: The Encrypt/Decrypt box isn't a safe place for secret key material. Use the Import flow so the key is loaded into the secure store and kept out of any draft snapshots.

workspace_private_key_import_safely.description: Button on the private-key alert that hands the pasted key to the import flow.

workspace_private_key_clear_input.description: Button on the private-key alert that empties the message box.

workspace_hide_technical_details.description: Toggle under an error message that collapses the raw error text.

workspace_show_technical_details.description: Toggle under an error message that reveals the raw error text.

workspace_unverified.description: Badge on the signer card when the message is signed but the signer's key is not held, so the signature could not be checked.

workspace_signature_verified.description: Status line and signer-card badge after a signature checked out.

workspace_output_size_line.description: One-line description of a binary result: $name$ is the file name, $size$ a formatted size like '12.3 KB'.

workspace_find_replace.description: Accessible label of the find bar and of the toolbar button that opens it.

workspace_find_hide_replace.description: Accessible label of the chevron that collapses the replace row of the find bar.

workspace_find_show_replace.description: Accessible label of the chevron that expands the replace row of the find bar.

workspace_find_label.description: Label and placeholder of the search field in the find bar. Very short.

workspace_replace_with.description: Label and placeholder of the replacement field in the find bar.

workspace_replace.description: Button that replaces the current match; also the tooltip of the chevron that opens the replace row. Narrow button, keep short.

workspace_replace_all_short.description: Very short button label meaning 'replace all matches'; sits next to 'Replace'. Must fit a narrow button.

workspace_replace_all.description: Accessible label of the 'All' button in the find bar.

workspace_replace_all_shortcut.description: Tooltip of the 'All' button. $shortcut$ is a keyboard shortcut like 'Ctrl+Enter'.

workspace_match_case.description: Tooltip and accessible label of the case-sensitivity toggle in the find bar.

workspace_previous_match.description: Tooltip and accessible label of the up-chevron in the find bar.

workspace_next_match.description: Tooltip and accessible label of the down-chevron in the find bar.

workspace_close_find.description: Tooltip and accessible label of the X that closes the find bar.

workspace_message_tools.description: Accessible label of the floating formatting toolbar in the message box.

workspace_style_bold.description: Formatting tool: wrap the selection in bold markers. Also used in the command palette and shortcut reference.

workspace_style_italic.description: Formatting tool: wrap the selection in italic markers.

workspace_style_strike.description: Formatting tool: wrap the selection in strikethrough markers.

workspace_style_code.description: Formatting tool: wrap the selection in code (monospace) markers.

workspace_translating.description: Hover label of the compose translate button while a translation runs.

workspace_translate_to.description: Label of the translate button once a target language is known. $language$ is a language name.

workspace_translate.description: Label of the compose translate button, which opens the language list.

workspace_translate_menu_heading.description: Heading of the language list in the compose translate menu.

workspace_search_languages.description: Placeholder of the search field in the compose translate menu.

workspace_no_such_language.description: Empty state of the language search in the compose translate menu.

workspace_restore_original.description: Menu item that puts the untranslated message back after a compose translation.

workspace_show_original.description: Label of the result-box toggle while the translation is showing; switches back to the original text.

workspace_show_translation.description: Label of the result-box toggle while the original is showing and a translation exists. $language$ is a language name.

workspace_working.description: Hover label of the result translate button while busy.

workspace_note_same_language.description: Status chip on the result box after detecting the message is already in the reading language. $language$ is a language name. One line, keep short.

workspace_note_uncertain.message: Not sure what language this message is in.
workspace_note_uncertain.description: Status chip on the result box when language detection was inconclusive. One line.

workspace_note_downloading_progress.description: Status chip while a translation model downloads. $what$ names the model (e.g. 'English to Spanish translator'), $percent$ is a whole number. One line.

workspace_note_downloading.description: Status chip while a translation model download has not reported progress yet. $what$ names the model.

workspace_note_translated_from.description: Status chip while a translation is showing. $language$ is the detected source language name.

workspace_drop_files_or_text.description: Text in the drag-and-drop zone above the message box.

workspace_browse_files.description: Button in the drop zone that opens the file picker.

workspace_clear_all_files.description: Button under the staged file list that removes every file.

workspace_detected_key_known.description: Banner when a pasted or received public key is already a contact. $name$ is the contact's name.

workspace_detected_key_show.description: Link in the banner for an already-held key; highlights it in the Keys tab.

workspace_detected_key_in_message.description: Banner under a decrypted/verified message that carries a public key. $name$ is the key owner's name.

workspace_detected_key_pasted.description: Banner when a public key is pasted into the message box. $name$ is the key owner's name.

workspace_detected_key_in_message_anon.message: This message contains someone's public key.
workspace_detected_key_in_message_anon.description: Banner under a decrypted/verified message that carries a public key whose owner could not be read.

workspace_detected_key_pasted_anon.message: This looks like someone's public key.
workspace_detected_key_pasted_anon.description: Banner when a public key is pasted into the message box and its owner could not be read.

workspace_detected_key_import.description: Link in the detected-key banner that opens the import flow with the key.

workspace_message_password_title.description: Title of the dialog where the message (symmetric encryption) password is typed.

workspace_set_password.description: Primary button of the message password dialog.

workspace_message_password_label.description: Label of the password field in the message password dialog.

workspace_hide_password.description: Tooltip/accessible label of the eye toggle when the password is shown.

workspace_show_password.description: Tooltip/accessible label of the eye toggle when the password is hidden.

workspace_password_too_short_one.description: Error under the message password field when the typed password is shorter than the minimum. $count$ is the minimum length.

workspace_password_too_short_other.description: Error under the message password field when the typed password is shorter than the minimum. $count$ is the minimum length.

workspace_password_min_length_one.description: Hint under the message password field stating the minimum length. $count$ is the minimum length.

workspace_password_min_length_other.description: Hint under the message password field stating the minimum length. $count$ is the minimum length.

workspace_message_password_help.message: Anyone with this password can read the message, so send it another way - not alongside the message itself. It is added to the message on top of any recipients you have picked; either can open it.
workspace_message_password_help.description: Help paragraph in the message password dialog.

workspace_history_save_failed.message: Couldn't save to history - storage may be full
workspace_history_save_failed.description: Error toast when recording an operation to history failed.

workspace_operation_failed.description: Generic error when an encrypt/decrypt/sign/verify threw an unclassified error.

workspace_error_need_recipient_or_passwo.message: Select at least one recipient key, or set a password.
workspace_error_need_recipient_or_passwo.description: Error when Encrypt is run with no recipients and no message password.

workspace_error_engine_mismatch.message: Couldn't work out which format to encrypt in.
workspace_error_engine_mismatch.description: Error when the recipient set does not resolve to a single format (OpenPGP or age). Should be unreachable.

workspace_status_age_encrypted.message: age message - encrypted to SSH recipients
workspace_status_age_encrypted.description: Status line after encrypting to SSH recipients (age format). 'age' is a format name, keep lowercase.

workspace_files_encrypted_one.description: Status line after encrypting several files separately. $count$ is the file count, $size$ a formatted total size like '1.2 MB'.

workspace_files_encrypted_other.description: Status line after encrypting several files separately. $count$ is the file count, $size$ a formatted total size like '1.2 MB'.

workspace_files_zipped_encrypted_one.description: Status line after bundling files into one zip and encrypting it. $count$ is the file count.

workspace_files_zipped_encrypted_other.description: Status line after bundling files into one zip and encrypting it. $count$ is the file count.

workspace_files_decrypted_one.description: Status line after decrypting several files. $count$ is the file count, $size$ a formatted total size.

workspace_files_decrypted_other.description: Status line after decrypting several files. $count$ is the file count, $size$ a formatted total size.

workspace_files_signed_one.description: Status line after signing several files. $count$ is the file count.

workspace_files_signed_other.description: Status line after signing several files. $count$ is the file count.

workspace_status_decrypted_archive.description: Status line when the decrypted result is a zip archive.

workspace_error_decrypt_failed_ssh.message: Decryption failed. The message may be corrupted, or it isn't encrypted to any of your SSH keys.
workspace_error_decrypt_failed_ssh.description: Error when an age message could not be decrypted.

workspace_error_decrypt_failed.message: Decryption failed. The message may be corrupted, or it isn't encrypted to any of your keys.
workspace_error_decrypt_failed.description: Error when a PGP message could not be decrypted and the cause was not classified.

workspace_error_select_decryption_key.description: Error when Decrypt is run with no private key selected.

workspace_unknown_signer.description: Name shown on the signer card when the message is signed by a key the user does not hold.

workspace_lookup_signer.description: Button on the unknown-signer card: look the signer's key id up on the keyserver to import their key. $host$ is the keyserver hostname (keys.openpgp.org).

workspace_status_signer_unknown.message: This message is signed, but the signer's public key isn't in your keys or contacts, so the signature could not be verified.
workspace_status_signer_unknown.description: Note on the signer card when the signature could not be checked because the signer's key is not held.

workspace_error_signature_invalid.message: Signature verification FAILED - this message may have been tampered with
workspace_error_signature_invalid.description: Error in verify mode when the signature does not match the message. Keep the emphasis on FAILED.

workspace_error_not_signed.description: Error in verify mode when the input carries no signature.

workspace_error_verify_failed.message: Verification failed. The input doesn't look like a signed PGP message.
workspace_error_verify_failed.description: Error in verify mode when the input could not be parsed.

workspace_error_no_signing_key_ssh.message: No signing key available. SSH keys can't sign - add an OpenPGP key first.
workspace_error_no_signing_key_ssh.description: Error in sign mode when the user only holds SSH keys.

workspace_error_no_signing_key.message: No signing key available. Add a key first.
workspace_error_no_signing_key.description: Error in sign mode when the user holds no keys at all.

workspace_status_crx_signed.description: Status line right after a Chrome extension package was signed and the save prompt opens. $name$ is the .crx file name.

workspace_error_crx_wrong_password.description: Error under the inline password field when signing a .crx with a password-protected key failed.

workspace_error_crx_sign_failed.description: Error when signing a Chrome extension package threw. 'CRX' is the package format name.

workspace_error_select_crx_key.message: Select a CRX signing key first.
workspace_error_select_crx_key.description: Error when Sign for Web Store is run with no extension signing key selected.

workspace_status_crx_valid.description: Status line after a .crx signature checked out. $id$ is the 32-letter Chrome extension ID.

workspace_error_crx_invalid.message: This file's CRX signature could not be verified.
workspace_error_crx_invalid.description: Error when a .crx file's signature does not check out.

workspace_error_read_file.message: Could not read this file. Try again.
workspace_error_read_file.description: Error when the staged file could not be read from disk.

workspace_error_wrong_key_password.message: Wrong password. Check it and try again.
workspace_error_wrong_key_password.description: Error under the inline password field when the key password was wrong.

workspace_error_unlock_failed.description: Error under the inline password field when unlocking the key threw.

workspace_reply.description: Button under a decrypted message from a verified signer. Opens a new browser tab with an encrypted reply addressed to them. Short: shares a row with Download and Copy.

workspace_reply_failed.description: Error toast when opening the reply tab fails.

workspace_reader_title.description: Browser tab title of the tab that shows a decrypted message while you reply to it. Keep "PGP Tools" as is. Use a hyphen, not a dash.

workspace_reader_locked.description: Shown under the logo, centred, in the message tab while the side panel is locked.

workspace_reader_unavailable.message: This message is no longer available.
workspace_reader_unavailable.description: Shown in a message tab that has nothing to show (for example it was reopened after the side panel closed).

workspace_char_count_one.description: Character count of the message, at the right end of the toolbar under the message box. $count$ is the number of characters.

workspace_char_count_other.description: Character count of the message, at the right end of the toolbar under the message box. $count$ is the number of characters.

workspace_signed_on.description: Part of the note under a verified signer. $date$ is the date the signature claims it was made (chosen by the signer).

workspace_signer_key_retired.message: the key that made it has since expired or been revoked
workspace_signer_key_retired.description: Part of the note under a signer: the signature verified, but the signing key is no longer valid today. Lowercase: it follows other parts after a dot separator.

workspace_also_signed_by.description: Part of the note under a verified signer: further good signatures. $names$ is a comma-separated list.

workspace_unverified_cosigners_one.message: $count$ more signature from a key you don't have
workspace_unverified_cosigners_one.description: Part of the note under a verified signer: extra signatures that could not be checked.

workspace_unverified_cosigners_other.message: $count$ more signatures from keys you don't have
workspace_unverified_cosigners_other.description: Part of the note under a verified signer: extra signatures that could not be checked.

workspace_files_mixed_signers.description: Name on the amber card after verifying or decrypting several files whose signatures differ. Keep it short; the note under it lists each file.

workspace_file_signature.description: One file's entry in the mixed-signers note. $name$ is the file name, $outcome$ the signer's name or a status.

workspace_file_not_signed.description: Outcome of one file in the mixed-signers note.

workspace_signature_covers_original.message: the signature covers the original, not this translation
workspace_signature_covers_original.description: Note under the signer card while a machine translation is shown in place of the signed message.

workspace_signature_verified_retired.description: Short amber label on a signer card: the signature checks out, but the key that made it has expired or been revoked since. Keep it to a couple of words; the note under the card explains.

workspace_signed_for_others.description: Part of the note under a verified signer: the signature names its intended recipients and none of them is the user (the message was passed on). $names$ is a comma-separated list. Lowercase: it may follow other parts.

workspace_signature_verified_not_for_you.description: Short amber label on a signer card: the signature checks out, but it names other people as its recipients (this copy was passed on). Keep it to a couple of words; the note under the card explains.

workspace_error_verify_file_too_large.message: $name$ is too large to verify here (limit $limit$).
workspace_error_verify_file_too_large.description: Verify error: a staged file is larger than any signed message the engine verifies. $name$ is the file name, $limit$ the size limit, e.g. '24 MB'.

workspace_error_verify_not_utf8.message: $name$ isn't UTF-8 text, so it can't be verified as a signed message.
workspace_error_verify_not_utf8.description: Verify error: a staged file has bytes that aren't valid UTF-8 (e.g. a Latin-1 file or a binary file). $name$ is the file name.

workspace_signed_text_hidden_chars.message: the signed text contains invisible or text-direction characters, so it may not read on screen the way it was written
workspace_signed_text_hidden_chars.description: Part of the note under a verified signer: the signed text itself contains bidi/zero-width/control characters that can make it display in a different order. Lowercase: it follows other parts after a dot separator.
